architectural_boundary.statement: Requirement 4.10 -- carry THIS fixture through run_route_e and verify_route_e_run -- cannot be satisfied without modifying production source. verify_route_e_run refuses, by design, any root that lacks ROUTE_E_PROVENANCE.json with the canonical tag, returning NOT_A_CANONICAL_ROUTE_E_ROOT and naming a generic measurement-bridge run as exactly the case it excludes. run_route_e derives every world frame from the engine: run_measurement_bridge takes law_spec and initial_state and builds its acquisition source as a private closure re-reading engine captures from disk. There is no frames, masks, acquisition_source or fixture parameter anywhere on that path.
architectural_boundary.consequence: A handcrafted mask sequence -- which is what the frozen test_r1 witness is, and what an EMPTY right frame requires, since the engine field does not vanish -- cannot become a Route E world. Requirement 3 (reuse the frozen test_r1 geometry exactly) and requirement 4.10 (carry that same fixture through verify_route_e_run) are jointly unsatisfiable under requirement 2 (production byte-identical).
